After an edit: python tools/localisation/gen_sorter_texts.py (writes tools/sorter/texts_table.inc), then tools/sorter/build.bat. python tools/localisation/check_locale.py checks the table.

en.T_GAME_NOT_FOUND: Not found: choose the Street Fighter 6 folder
en.T_INDEX_MISSING: Slots Loader not installed here ({0} is missing)
en.T_DROP_SUB: As downloaded: archives (.zip, .7z, .rar), folders or .pak files
en.T_DROP_KINDS: Costumes, stages, interface packs, title packs and colours each go to their own folder of the game
en.T_ST_EXISTS: Already there: choose Skip or Replace
en.T_NOTE: Mods are read when the game starts: start it, or restart it, after installing.
en.T_NOTE_DONE: Done. Mods are read when the game starts: start it, or restart it, to see them.
en.T_NOTE_RUNNING: The game is running: mods are read when it starts, restart it to see the ones you install.
en.T_NOTE_DONE_RUNNING: Done. The game is running: restart it to see them.
en.T_NOTE_LAUNCH_FAILED: Steam could not be asked to start the game.
en.T_NOTE_INSTALLED: What is already in the game folder, by category.
en.T_NOTE_MOVED: Moved to {0}. The game sees it at its next start.
en.T_NOTE_MOVE_EXISTS: Not moved: a mod of the same name is already in {0}.
en.T_NOTE_MOVE_FAILED: Not moved: {0}. Close what may be using it and try again.
en.T_NSFW_NONE: No: nothing in its name says so
en.T_NSFW_OPTIONS: {0} of its options are NSFW by their own name: they become NSFW options of the outfit
en.T_NSFW_OPTION_1: 1 of its options is NSFW by its own name: it becomes an NSFW option of the outfit
en.T_NSFW_HINT: Yes puts it in costume_mods_nsfw: in game only with Display NSFW Outfits on
en.T_F_PARTS: {0} · {1}: parts, an option of that outfit
en.T_F_MULTI_ARCHIVE: Several fighters: the archive goes in costume_mods itself, the loader reads it there
en.T_F_MULTI_FOLDER: Several fighters: the loader reads it in any of their folders, the first one is used
en.T_F_STAGE_TILE: {0}: another stage over it (a cell of its own): {1}
en.T_F_GUI_ONLY: {0} stage menu pictures (not used by stage mods)
en.R_NOT_FOUND: The file or folder is not there any more
en.R_SCRIPT: A Lua script: REFramework scripts are not sorted here (they go in reframework\autorun)
en.R_TEXT: A text file, not a mod
en.R_OTHER_FILE: A {0} file: neither an archive, a folder nor a .pak
en.R_ARCHIVE_UNREADABLE: The archive cannot be read (damaged, or its names are encrypted)
en.R_NOTHING_INSIDE: No natives folder, .pak or colour file inside: nothing the loaders read
en.R_PAK_UNKNOWN: None of its {0} files is a costume or stage file (a .pak is never read as an interface pack)
en.R_PAK_UNREADABLE: Not a pak the game can read
en.R_OTHER_FILES: Its files are not costumes, stages, interface, title screens or colours (for example {0})
en.R_NO_COSTUME_INDEX: Costume files, but the Slots Loader is not installed in this game folder ({0} is missing)
en.R_NO_STAGE_INDEX: Stage files, but the Slots Loader is not installed in this game folder ({0} is missing)
en.R_COSTUME_PARTS_UNKNOWN: Costume files, but for no outfit the loader knows: {0}
en.R_EMPTY_COLOUR: An empty colour file (the Color Mod skips it)
en.R_NO_GAME: No game folder yet: choose it (G) to recognise costumes and stages
en.R_PAK_NO_INDEX: A .pak names its files by numbers only: without the Slots Loader in this game folder ({0} is missing) it cannot be recognised
en.E_SOURCE_GONE: the original is not there any more
en.E_REPLACE: the old copy cannot be replaced ({0})
en.D_NOT_GAME: StreetFighter6.exe is not in this folder.
en.T_NOTE_OPTIONS: The language chosen here is kept for the next time.
en.T_UP_OLD: Some packages were installed before 1.32.0 and cannot be updated from here: install the latest release by hand once.
en.T_NOTE_UPDATE: SF6 Mod Suite {0} is out: install it from the Options tab.
en.T_NOTE_UPDATE_HERE: SF6 Mod Suite {0} is out: press F to install it.
en.T_NOTE_UPDATE_RUNNING: SF6 Mod Suite {0} is out: close the game to install it from here.
en.T_NOTE_UPDATED: SF6 Mod Suite {0} is installed. If you use Fluffy Mod Manager, replace the zip there too: the new one is in reframework\data\SF6_Update_data\downloads (O shows it).
en.T_NOTE_UPDATES: The latest release of SF6 Mod Suite is looked up on GitHub when this tool starts; it is installed from here with the game closed.
en.T_NOTE_UPDATE_FAILED: The latest release could not be read: check your connection, then press F.
en.T_NOTE_SELF_UPDATES: A newer version of this tool is looked up on GitHub when it starts; it is installed from here, then the tool starts again.
en.T_NOTE_SELF_UPDATE: Version {0} of this tool is out: install it from the Options tab.
en.T_NOTE_SELF_UPDATE_HERE: Version {0} of this tool is out: press F to install it; the tool then starts again.
en.T_NOTE_SELF_UPDATED: Version {0} of this tool is installed: close it and start it again.
